title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
task: Evaluating data policies for RLVR training in language models
key_results: Uniform GRPO improves accuracy by 7.76pp over baseline; no rollout-selection or reweighting method achieves statistically significant improvement over uniform sampling
comments: Rigorous controlled evaluation across multiple seeds and models reveals the difficulty of improving over simple uniform data policies, with concerning evaluation sensitivity across benchmark subsets.

inputs: training data batches with varied policies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rollout-selection or reweighting methods improve over uniform sampling
hypotheses.result: False - no method achieved 95% CI excluding zero relative improvement

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adaptive mixtures outperform fixed equal mixture
hypotheses.result: False - fixed equal mixture remains competitive

title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
task: Discovering and cataloging AI benchmarks at scale
key_results: Catalog contains 1,283 source records from 4 benchmarks and 12,916 numeric observations on 790 records; 37 discovery sources with daily updates
comments: A valuable infrastructure contribution for benchmark research, though maintaining ground truth at scale and handling score comparability remain open challenges.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Daily discovery from 37 sources can maintain a comprehensive, up-to-date benchmark catalog
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed: achieved 1,283 records but coverage and saturation analysis suggest selection biases

title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
task: Training open-weight cyber security agents
key_results: Feyospace-s1 achieves 63.24% verified success on CyberGym, ranks 10th on leaderboard; three checkpoints improve by avg 23.76% on full suite, 1st among comparable parameter scales
comments: Demonstrates that data-centric post-training with execution verification and multi-turn supervision can scale cyber agent capability without massive model size, though relies on custom infrastructure.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-turn supervision with execution verification enables comparable-scale models to reach leading cyber capability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: checkpoints rank 1st among comparable parameter scales

title: Breaking the Vision-Action Shortcut: Latent Interface Training for Generalizable Robotics Foundation Models
task: Improving robot foundation models under visual distribution shifts
key_results: Latent Interface Training (LIT) improves LIBERO-Plus success by 3.87-10.70 points across four architectures; real-world gains of 13.30-16.70 points under camera/lighting variations and distractors
comments: Addresses a critical limitation of vision-language-action models by decoupling goal-directed action priors from visual inputs, though evaluation remains largely in simulation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Constraining visual conditioning through pose-supervised latent interface preserves task-relevant spatial info while reducing vision-action shortcuts
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: consistent improvements across four architectures and real-world scenarios

title: SAS: Simple Attention Sparsification via End-to-End Optimization of Context Ranking
task: Efficient attention sparsification via end-to-end optimization
key_results: SAS consistently outperforms sparse attention baselines across reasoning, long-context, and agentic tasks; especially large gains under tight attention budgets
comments: Simple yet effective approach that aligns selector optimization directly with downstream loss rather than distilling dense attention, though specific numerical improvements are not quantified.

model_io.model: Transformer with gated sparse attention (SAS mechanism)

hypotheses.hypothesis: End-to-end optimization of context ranking with language modeling loss improves sparse attention over distillation-based methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: consistent outperformance across multiple task types and budgets

title: COBRA-Skills: Contextual Bandit-Guided Evolution for Agent Skill Optimization
task: Efficient skill optimization for LLM agents via contextual bandits
key_results: COBRA-Skills achieves strongest average performance across six benchmarks, reduces optimization cost by 55-58% relative to SkillOpt, uses only 50 examples per benchmark
comments: Combines bandit-based prioritization with evolutionary skill refinement to enable practical skill optimization with limited budget, though evaluation focuses on efficiency rather than absolute skill quality.

model_io.model: LLM agent with skill library (three target models tested)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Contextual-bandit-guided prioritization reduces evaluation cost while maintaining skill optimization performance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 55-58% cost reduction with best average performance across benchmarks

title: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
task: Unified general-purpose audio generation from text
key_results: State-of-the-art on TTS and voice design; achieves strong performance across speech, vocals, sound effects, music; uses discrete autoregressive modeling over RVQ tokens
comments: Departing from diffusion paradigm to use autoregressive discrete generation is interesting, but quantitative comparisons against recent models are not provided in abstract.

model_io.model: StepAudio 3 Gen (autoregressive Transformer over RVQ codes)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Discrete autoregressive modeling over shared RVQ representation enables unified audio generation across domains
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieves state-of-the-art on TTS and voice design with strong cross-domain performance

title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization
task: Robust preference optimization under noisy and ambiguous labels
key_results: PLC-DPO achieves 60.5% mean win rate vs 55.5% for next-best method across 57 dataset-model-benchmark cells; stable under injected noise and human disagreement
comments: Addresses a practical but understudied problem in preference learning by routing training signals rather than filtering, though improvements over baselines are modest.

model_io.model: Language model with Direct Preference Optimization variant (PLC-DPO)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Using policy-reference margin to route preference pairs as clean/flip/tie improves robustness to label noise
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 60.5% win rate and stable performance under noise and human disagreement stress tests

title: Beyond Top-k Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
task: Diversity-aware skill routing for LLM agents over large registries
key_results: DSR (Determinantal Point Process-based reranking) improves recall and full coverage over pointwise ranking, with larger gains on multi-skill queries
comments: Treats skill selection as complementary set selection rather than relevance ranking, which is intuitive for complex tasks but evaluation metrics beyond recall are not detailed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Balancing relevance and non-redundancy via DPP improves skill selection for multi-skill tasks
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: larger gains on multi-skill queries compared to pointwise baseline

title: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
task: Online adaptive routing of prompts to LLM experts under limited feedback
key_results: Achieves O(dT/m) regret in full-information setting and O(dTK/m) in bandit setting with feedback budget m; empirically learns efficient routing strategies
comments: Applies classic bandit theory to LLM expert selection but experimental details and concrete performance numbers are minimal in abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bandit algorithms can efficiently route to LLM experts with sublinear regret under limited feedback
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieved sublinear regret bounds O(dT/m) and O(dTK/m)

title: SNAP3D: Physically Grounded 3D Parts for Assembly from a Single Image
task: Physically grounded 3D part assembly generation from single images
key_results: Resolves inter-part penetration, recovers contact graphs, stabilizes assemblies under gravity; validated via 3D printing and real-world assembly
comments: Introduces physics-based constraints and evaluation into generative 3D modeling, though no quantitative metrics comparing geometric vs. physical quality are provided.

model_io.model: Physics-guided 3D part generator with simulation feedback

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics simulation feedback can improve part-aware 3D generation toward physically valid assemblies
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: substantial improvements in physical realizability and stability with maintained geometric quality

title: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
task: Proactive intervention timing in egocentric video for wearable assistants
key_results: Ranked 1st in large-model and 2nd in <=2B divisions; single-token classification improves macro-F1 by 0.249 and G-mean by 0.30 over generation
comments: Visual grounding in supervision proved more important than annotation volume, suggesting data quality significantly outweighs quantity for this domain.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-token classification outperforms free-form generation for intervention timing
hypotheses.result: True - macro-F1 +0.249, G-mean +0.30

hypotheses.hypothesis: Visual grounding in labels transfers better than larger narration-only datasets
hypotheses.result: True - visually-grounded supervision from unrelated corpus outperformed 10× larger narration-only data

title: Ambient @ EgoLongQA 2026: Distilling Long-Video perception into a Sub-2B Model
task: Long-video question answering in sub-2B egocentric vision models
key_results: 2B model achieves 81.4% accuracy (27.1pp improvement over base), reaching 89% of 186B agentic pipeline performance; pruning embedding table maintains logit identity while reducing params to 1.9985B
comments: Demonstrates effective knowledge distillation from agentic systems into efficient students, though embedding table manipulation feels like parameter gaming.

model_io.model: 2B vision-language model (distilled from larger agentic pipeline)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Distilling perceptual modules from tool-using agents yields efficient students
hypotheses.result: True - 2B student reaches 89% of 186B pipeline accuracy

hypotheses.hypothesis: Filtering teacher traces to correct answers improves student learning
hypotheses.result: True - enables 27.1pp improvement over base model

title: Studying Without a Syllabus: Task-Agnostic Environment Preprocessing
task: Task-agnostic environment preprocessing for LLM agents
key_results: Meta-agent achieves highest Avg@3 reward on 5/6 benchmarks; studied artifacts reduce required test-time sampling; larger study budgets show inconsistent improvements
comments: Interesting framing of pre-task preparation, but unclear practical advantage since computation shifts rather than reduces overall.

inputs: unfamiliar environment, corpus, tools, exploration budget
outputs: reusable artifacts (indices, scripts, guidance), improved solver performance

hypotheses.hypothesis: Meta-agents outperform fixed preparation strategies across diverse environments
hypotheses.result: Partially true - meta-agent best on 5/6 benchmarks; corpus processing best on largest

hypotheses.hypothesis: Studied artifacts reduce test-time sampling requirements
hypotheses.result: True - preparation shifts computation to pre-task phase

title: ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models
task: In-flight action editing for chunk-autoregressive video world models
key_results: CST*_R reduces rollback-relative LPIPS by 61.5-75.9%; CST*_T provides 1.69-2.73× speedup over waiting while reducing suffix LPIPS by 56.1-77.5%
comments: Clever inference-time solution avoiding expensive rollbacks, though applicability limited to specific world model architectures.

inputs: interrupted video generation state, revised action
outputs: corrected video chunk continuation with LPIPS/PSNR/SSIM metrics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lightweight corrector can transport state toward counterfactual action without replaying
hypotheses.result: True - CST framework demonstrates 1.69-2.73× speedup

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal-splicing variant preserves quality while speeding up inference
hypotheses.result: True - CST*_T achieves competitive LPIPS with significant speedup

title: TRACE: Trajectory-robust Admission with Evidence Ordering for Efficient GUI Agents
task: Training-free visual token pruning for efficient GUI agents
key_results: TRACE maintains nested token order across budgets; monotone KV contraction avoids repeated encoding; effectiveness verified across 6 GUI benchmarks
comments: Well-motivated problem with elegant solution combining layout priors and feature diversity, though quantitative improvements not explicitly stated in abstract.

model_io.model: GUI agent with visual token pruning
inputs: high-resolution screenshots accumulated in trajectory, layout information
outputs: pruned visual tokens with preserved spatial coverage and evidence ordering

hypotheses.hypothesis: Layout-derived priors improve token admission decisions over query-independent methods
hypotheses.result: True - ranking by interaction prior, relevance, and novelty produces better coverage

hypotheses.hypothesis: Monotone KV contraction enables token budget flexibility without re-encoding
hypotheses.result: True - nested token ordering allows shrinkage while remaining reusable

title: Towards a Deterministic Math Solver for Clinical Language Models
task: Reliable arithmetic computation for clinical calculators using LLMs
key_results: Program-Solve interface achieves 90.53% accuracy on Qwen2.5-32B (+7.05pp vs direct arithmetic), but only 75.31% on 7B (+3.29pp); hand-written library achieves 100% on supported cases but only 40% overall coverage
comments: The work reveals that deterministic solvers help larger models more than smaller ones, and highlights that formula verification and variable extraction remain critical bottlenecks independent of computation method.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Offloading arithmetic to a deterministic solver improves reliability over direct model arithmetic
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for 32B model (+7.05pp, CI excludes zero) but not reliably for 7B model (CI includes zero)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Program-Solve interface outperforms hand-written calculator library
hypotheses.result: No; library achieves 100% on supported cases, though Program-Solve achieves higher overall coverage (90.53% vs 40%)

title: Building and Evaluating Fixed-Voice Thai TTS from Synthetic Speech
task: Building compact fixed-voice Thai TTS from synthetic data
key_results: 82M-parameter Wayu-Paxa-TTS-Edge achieves 68.2% Challenge-Set Keyword Accuracy (85.5% of Gemini 3.1), 91.4% pause precision, 3.7% CER on Thai, 1.1% CER on English
comments: Demonstrates practical pipeline design for low-resource TTS via synthetic data distillation, with thorough ablation of text preparation and filtering steps.

model_io.model: Fixed-voice TTS student (82M parameters, trained on synthetic speech)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic speech from voice-cloning teacher can train compact student TTS competitive with larger systems
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: achieves 85.5% of Gemini 3.1 performance and outperforms OmniVoice teacher on pause metrics

title: How Far Can Synthetic Data Take Thai OCR?
task: Thai OCR adaptation via synthetic data without OCR labels
key_results: Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero achieves 1.82% median CER on printed pages (vs. 1.31% with real labels), 20.55% on handwriting; outperforms Typhoon OCR 7B across five evaluation sets
comments: Rigorous controlled study disentangling factors in synthetic document realism, showing structure and glyph diversity matter more than photorealism.

inputs: real Thai document pages for evaluation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Controlled synthetic document generation with typeface diversity and real handwriting glyphs transfers to real Thai OCR
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: synthetic-only training achieves 1.82% CER (competitive with 1.31% on real), outperforms 7B baseline

title: Structural and mechanistic insights into OCTN1-mediated transport and cancer cell proliferation
task: Determine structural mechanism of OCTN1 substrate recognition and identify cancer-targeting inhibitors
key_results: Cryo-EM structures of human OCTN1 in apo and ergothioneine-bound states; mebendazole identified as potent OCTN1 inhibitor suppressing cervical and lung cancer cell proliferation
comments: Structure-function work elegantly bridges transporter mechanism to cancer biology, though the direct mechanistic link between OCTN1-mediated ACh transport and tumor proliferation remains incompletely characterized.

inputs: cervical and lung cancer cell lines

hypotheses.hypothesis: OCTN1 adopts distinct conformations for sodium-dependent substrate transport; structure enables rational inhibitor design
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: cryo-EM resolved apo and ET-bound states; mebendazole identified and validated as cancer cell growth suppressor

title: CFM: confinement force microscopy—a dynamic, precise and stable microconfiner for traction force microscopy in spatial confinement
task: Develop and validate confinement force microscopy (CFM) to measure traction forces under dynamic spatial confinement
key_results: CFM resolved two-phase cellular stress response: rapid passive compression followed by active stress increase; ROCK and myosin II inhibitors differentially affect blebbing and stress generation
comments: Elegant platform bridging live-cell imaging with quantitative force measurement in tissue-like geometry; the causal relationship between bleb formation and pressure relief would benefit from direct volumetric measurements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cells exhibit distinct passive and active phases of mechanical adaptation to confinement; contractile machinery and bleb dynamics are separable contributors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: two-phase response identified; ROCK and myosin II inhibition show distinct phenotypes

title: Exposure of human tissues to stratosphere radiation behind different shielding from a campaign of three balloon flights
task: Quantify DNA damage in human cells exposed to stratospheric radiation under different shielding
key_results: Stratospheric radiation induced severe double-strand breaks (DSBs) in frozen human cells; lens and bone cells showed highest radiosensitivity; DSB severity increased with repair time depending on shielding material
comments: While biologically relevant, this work measures ionizing radiation effects rather than addressing core biophysical mechanisms at the cellular or molecular level.

inputs: human fibroblasts, epithelial lens, osteoblasts, heart myocytes
multi-alveolar containers with variable shielding materials
outputs: DNA double-strand break (DSB) counts via immunofluorescence

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stratospheric radiation produces measurable DSBs in human cells; severity correlates with shielding and tissue type
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: DSBs increased with repair time; lens and bone cells most radiosensitive

title: Microscale droplets for mechanical measurement and mechanotransduction in artificial and living systems
task: Engineer and characterize microscale droplets as biointerfaces for mechanical measurement and mechanotransduction
key_results: Microscale liquid droplets and hydrogel beads enable non-invasive mechanical detection and stimulus-responsive transduction; applications include cellular force sensors and drug delivery
comments: This is a review synthesizing emerging droplet-based platforms; experimental validation across specific applications would strengthen claims about mechanotransduction fidelity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Microscale droplets can recapitulate key cellular mechanical responses and serve as tunable mechanotransduction platforms
hypotheses.result: Supported: diverse applications demonstrated including force sensors and controlled release, though specific quantitative validations vary by system

title: 3D cell-matrix mechanical interaction models for cancer invasion
task: Decouple biophysical and biochemical mechanisms of cancer cell invasion using force-responsive hydrogels
key_results: Breast cancer cells invaded force-responsive polyisocyanide (PIC) hydrogels despite MMP inhibition; CAFs accelerated invasion via force-induced fiber alignment; MMP inhibitors ineffective in PIC but effective in Matrigel
comments: This work powerfully demonstrates that protease-independent, force-driven invasion is a major mechanism overlooked by standard biochemical assays, with important implications for anti-metastatic drug evaluation.

outputs: invasion depth and cell-generated fiber alignment
pericellular stiffening and long-range force transmission
predicted matrix remodeling and pericellular stiffness profiles

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cancer cells can invade via force-driven matrix remodeling independent of protease activity; CAFs enhance invasion through mechanical rather than purely biochemical mechanisms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: MMP inhibition fails in PIC but succeeds in Matrigel; CAFs accelerate invasion via fiber alignment; mechanical bypass of protease blockade demonstrated

hypotheses.hypothesis: Matrigel-based invasion assays may obscure biophysical mechanisms critical for in vivo metastasis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: same MMP inhibitors show opposite efficacy in PIC vs. Matrigel, highlighting platform-dependent limitations

title: Targeting the PRMT5-CBX8 axis overcomes dual barriers of CD8⁺ T cell exclusion and tumor stemness for sensitizing TNBC to anti-PD-1 therapy
task: Identify PRMT5-CBX8 epigenetic axis regulating CD8+ T cell exclusion and tumor stemness in TNBC
key_results: PRMT5 methylates CBX8, facilitating USP7 interaction and K33-deubiquitination; methylated CBX8 drives PCSK9 (CD8+ T cell exclusion) and LGR5 (tumor stemness) transcription; PRMT5 inhibition sensitizes TNBC to anti-PD-1 therapy in vivo
comments: Elegant mechanistic dissection of post-translational modification dynamics; however, PRMT5 global methylation effects on other immune regulators beyond the CBX8-PCSK9-LGR5 axis require characterization.

model_io.model: TNBC xenografts with PRMT5 inhibition and anti-PD-1

hypotheses.hypothesis: PRMT5-mediated methylation of CBX8 facilitates USP7 interaction, enabling CBX8-driven transcription of PCSK9 and LGR5 to exclude CD8+ T cells and enhance tumor stemness
hypotheses.result: PRMT5 inhibition reduced PCSK9/LGR5 expression and sensitized TNBC to anti-PD-1 therapy in vivo; PRMT5-CBX8 axis regulates CD8+ T cell exclusion and stemness

title: Homeobox a4 is proapoptotic in the AC16 human cardiomyocyte cell line and a key effector of the MIAT/miR-150 axis in murine myocardial infarction
task: Establish functional relationships among MIAT, miR-150, and HOXA4 in cardiomyocyte apoptosis and post-MI remodeling
key_results: HOXA4 is proapoptotic in AC16 cardiomyocytes; miR-150 suppresses HOXA4 expression and exerts cardioprotection; Hoxa4 ablation attenuates post-MI remodeling; miR-150;Hoxa4 double knockout and MIAT transgenic;Hoxa4 knockout models confirm in vivo functional axis
comments: Rigorous genetic models establish regulatory relationships, but HOXA4-independent effects of miR-150 and MIAT on cardiac function warrant additional investigation.

inputs: Wild-type, Hoxa4 KO, miR-150;Hoxa4 DKO, MIAT transgenic;Hoxa4 KO mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: MIAT represses miR-150, which suppresses proapoptotic HOXA4; this axis regulates cardiomyocyte apoptosis and post-MI remodeling
hypotheses.result: HOXA4 promotes apoptosis; miR-150 is cardioprotective via HOXA4 repression; Hoxa4 ablation blunts adverse effects of miR-150 loss or MIAT gain in post-MI remodeling

title: RICTOR regulates an interspecies crosstalk that influences longevity through a methionine cycle-mitophagy axis
task: Characterize RICTOR's role in dietary plasticity and longevity through methionine metabolism and mitophagy
key_results: rict-1/RICTOR loss conferred enhanced osmotic stress tolerance and longevity on B12-rich diets; elevated succinate-induced mitochondrial fragmentation and sustained mitophagy in aged mutants compared to wild-type
comments: The study elegantly demonstrates host-microbe metabolic crosstalk but mechanisms governing differential diet-genotype interactions in other organisms remain unexplored.

model_io.model: C. elegans rict-1 mutant on B12-rich diet

hypotheses.hypothesis: RICTOR restrains host sensitivity to microbe-derived metabolites via organellar quality control
hypotheses.result: rict-1 mutants showed elevated succinate-induced mitochondrial fragmentation and enhanced mitophagy, correlating with stress resilience and longevity

title: Canonical mTOR protein supports complete fin regeneration with selective effects on myeloid transcriptional programs
task: Determine whether canonical mTOR protein is sufficient to support complex appendage regeneration in ray-finned fish
key_results: Fin amputation triggered rapid mTOR activation; mTOR inhibition abolished regeneration despite wound closure; mTOR selectively regulated translational machinery and glycolysis in proliferating cells; disproportionate effects on myeloid interferon-associated signaling
comments: The study refutes the hypothesis that salamander mTOR hypersensitivity is essential for limb regeneration, but the evolutionary significance of myeloid-specific effects requires clarification.

inputs: Regenerating fin tissue at multiple timepoints

hypotheses.hypothesis: Salamander-specific mTOR hypersensitivity is required for complex appendage regeneration
hypotheses.result: Canonical mTOR in ray-finned fish supports complete fin regeneration; mTOR inhibition abolished regeneration, suggesting salamander hypersensitivity represents evolutionary acceleration rather than necessity

title: A food-derived bioactive small molecule DRL-7 enhances bone marrow stem cell function via CXCL12-CXCR4–PI3K-Akt signaling
task: Identify and validate mechanisms by which food-derived DRL-7 enhances bone marrow stem cell function and bone regeneration
key_results: DRL-7 enhanced BMSC proliferation, migration, and osteogenic differentiation; trabecular bone microarchitecture and BMD improved in ovariectomized mice; mechanistically, DRL-7 activated CXCL12/CXCR4–PI3K/Akt signaling with FAK and PI3K inhibition abolishing benefits
comments: Strong multi-omics validation in preclinical models, but translation to human postmenopausal osteoporosis requires clinical trials; rodent efficacy does not guarantee human relevance.

model_io.model: Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) with DRL-7 treatment

hypotheses.hypothesis: DRL-7 promotes BMSC function and bone regeneration via CXCL12/CXCR4–PI3K/Akt pathway activation
hypotheses.result: DRL-7 enhanced osteogenic differentiation and bone regeneration; FAK/PI3K inhibition abolished benefits, confirming pathway dependence

title: E12.5 pancreatic bud-derived cells are detected in recipient pancreata after intraplacental transplantation, but Pdx1-deficient recipients lack a macroscopically detectable pancreas
task: Determine whether pancreatic bud-derived cells can form organized pancreatic tissue in Pdx1-deficient recipient contexts
key_results: E12.5 pancreatic bud-derived cells localized within endocrine, acinar, and ductal compartments in non-knockout recipients; Pdx1-deficient recipients did not form macroscopically detectable organized pancreatic tissue; transient postnatal glucose elevation followed by hypoglycemia in KO recipients
comments: Intraplacental transplantation model demonstrates cell fate plasticity, but Pdx1-deficient recipients' apparent failure to form organized tissue suggests Pdx1 is essential for pancreatic tissue architecture despite intrinsic cell developmental potential.

model_io.model: Intraplacental transplantation of E12.5 pancreatic bud cells
Single-cell RNA-seq analysis of E12.5 pancreatic bud

hypotheses.hypothesis: E12.5 pancreatic bud-derived cells retain developmental potential to form organized pancreatic tissue when transplanted into appropriate recipient contexts
hypotheses.result: Donor cells localized within pancreatic compartments in non-KO recipients; failed to form organized tissue in Pdx1-deficient recipients, indicating recipient pancreatic field is essential for tissue organization

title: Hcn4-deficient zebrafish embryos develop a normal left‒right axis
task: Determine whether HCN4 channel activity is necessary for left-right axis specification in zebrafish
key_results: Hcn4-deficient zebrafish embryos developed a normal left-right axis, contradicting prior Xenopus findings suggesting HCN4 involvement in early LR asymmetry
comments: The title and abstract present a negative result that challenges existing hypotheses; mechanistic explanation for inter-species differences in HCN4 function remains undetermined.

hypotheses.hypothesis: HCN4-mediated ion fluxes regulate early left-right axis specification
hypotheses.result: Hcn4-deficient zebrafish embryos developed normal left-right axis, contradicting this hypothesis and suggesting species-specific mechanisms

title: Extracellular vesicles derived from embryonic day 13 fetal mouse dermal fibroblasts exhibit potential antifibrotic activity
task: Identify antifibrotic properties of fetal dermal fibroblast-derived extracellular vesicles
key_results: E13D EVs reduced TGF-β1-induced fibrotic markers in E17 fascia fibroblasts and attenuated human keloid fibroblast phenotype; E17F EVs enhanced fibrotic responses
comments: The study establishes EV-mediated transfer of antifibrotic factors but lacks detailed characterization of specific microRNAs and proteins responsible for the observed effects.

hypotheses.hypothesis: E13 dermal fibroblasts possess intrinsic antifibrotic properties transferred via EVs
hypotheses.result: E13D EVs attenuated TGF-β1-induced fibrosis in E17 and keloid fibroblasts; E17F EVs enhanced fibrosis

title: Lavender essential oil coordinates epidermal GABA shunt and nucleotide turnover to rescue cortisol-induced stress damage
task: Elucidate mechanisms by which lavender essential oil rescues cortisol-induced epidermal stress
key_results: TLEO reduced ROS (H2AX, stress markers), lipid peroxidation (MDA), and inflammation (COX-2, IL-8, IL-17); coordinated upregulation of GABA-shunt enzymes (ABAT, ALDH5A1, GLUL) and nucleotide metabolism genes (ADSL, ADSS2, TYMS)
comments: Multi-omic integration is thorough, but direct biochemical validation of metabolite-level changes would strengthen mechanistic claims beyond transcriptional correlation.

model_io.model: Cortisol-stimulated HaCaT keratinocytes with TLEO treatment

hypotheses.hypothesis: TLEO alleviates cortisol-induced epidermal stress by modulating GABA-shunt and nucleotide metabolism
hypotheses.result: Coordinated upregulation of GABA-related enzymes and nucleotide metabolism genes; reduced DNA damage response and inflammatory markers

title: Opisthorchis viverrini infection is associated with kidney injury involving excretory–secretory product-mediated inflammation, oxidative stress, and hypoxia
task: Characterize kidney injury mechanisms during chronic Opisthorchis viverrini infection
key_results: Infected hamsters exhibited glomerular enlargement, tubule dilation, podocyte foot-process effacement, and mitochondrial cristae disruption; parasite-derived soluble products induced NF-κB activation and apoptosis in HK-2 cells
comments: The transcriptomic analysis identifies multiple pathways implicated in injury, but causative relationships between individual pathways and kidney pathology require additional mechanistic validation.

model_io.model: Non-contact co-culture of HK-2 cells with parasite soluble products

hypotheses.hypothesis: Parasite-derived soluble products induce kidney injury through inflammatory and mitochondrial stress pathways
hypotheses.result: Parasite products reduced HK-2 viability, induced NF-κB activation, ROS accumulation, and apoptosis; kidney transcriptomics identified hypoxia, TNFα-NF-κB, TGF-β, and mitochondrial pathways

title: An active TCA cycle state defines a high-risk acute lymphoblastic leukemia subtype
task: Identify metabolic determinants of ALL heterogeneity and define high-risk subtype driven by TCA cycle activity
key_results: Single-cell metabolic landscape identified three TCA cycle states; highly active (H-A) TCA state correlates with developmental immaturity and poor survival; H-A subtype shows venetoclax resistance; PA2G4 and YBX1 inhibition synergizes with venetoclax to suppress leukemia
comments: Novel metabolically-driven subtype classification is well-supported, but the generalizability across diverse ALL genetic subtypes and therapeutic contexts requires validation.

model_io.model: Single-cell transcriptional metabolic landscape of ALL
H-A subtype ALL cells with PA2G4/YBX1 inhibition and venetoclax

hypotheses.hypothesis: High TCA cycle activity defines a high-risk ALL subtype with inferior survival and venetoclax resistance
hypotheses.result: H-A TCA state correlated with developmental immaturity and poor survival; PA2G4/YBX1 inhibition attenuated TCA flux and synergized with venetoclax

title: Integrated multi-omics reveals ITGB2 drives the mesenchymal transition in glioblastoma via FAK signaling
task: Identify ITGB2 as core regulator of mesenchymal transition and therapeutic vulnerability in glioblastoma
key_results: ITGB2 upregulated in GBM and co-localized with mesenchymal niches; ITGB2 promotes proliferation and invasion via FAK–AKT–mTOR axis; FAK inhibition attenuates ITGB2-driven phenotype; ITGB2 knockdown suppressed xenograft growth
comments: Comprehensive multi-omics integration with in vivo validation is strong; however, ITGB2 dependency may vary across GBM molecular subtypes and patient populations.

model_io.model: Bulk, single-cell, and spatial GBM transcriptomics with WGCNA and machine learning
GBM cells with ITGB2 modulation and FAK inhibition

hypotheses.hypothesis: ITGB2 drives GBM mesenchymal transition and malignant progression through FAK–AKT–mTOR signaling
hypotheses.result: ITGB2 preferentially upregulated in MES niches; ITGB2 promotes FAK signaling-dependent proliferation and invasion; FAK inhibition and ITGB2 knockdown suppressed xenograft growth

title: Biomolecular condensates in cancer therapy
task: Review mechanisms by which dysregulated liquid-liquid phase separation contributes to cancer pathogenesis and identify therapeutic targeting strategies
key_results: LLPS dysregulation implicated in multiple cancer hallmarks; tumorigenesis and key signaling pathways modulated by aberrant condensates; bioengineering approaches including D-amino-acid-based interfering peptides, post-translational modification-mimetic strategies, and synthetic condensates show therapeutic potential
comments: Comprehensive review integrating mechanistic insights with translational strategies, but clinical translation of LLPS-targeting therapeutics remains nascent with limited validated leads.

title: GLM-Prior: a genomic language model for transferable sequence-derived priors in gene regulatory network inference
task: Gene regulatory network inference using sequence-derived priors
key_results: GLM-Prior achieves highest prior performance in 4/5 mammalian cell lines; integrates with single-cell data for improved GRN inference across species
comments: Prior quality is identified as a major bottleneck; transferability across species is promising but performance depends heavily on label abundance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sequence information alone can generate informative GRN priors without species-matched experimental assays
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GLM-Prior produces competitive priors in mammalian settings

hypotheses.hypothesis: Priors transfer across related mammalian species
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; multi-species training shows transferability

title: scTransMIL bridges patient-level disease states and single-cell transcriptomics for cancer screening and heterogeneity inference
task: Linking single-cell transcriptomics to sample-level cancer phenotypes
key_results: scTransMIL accurately predicts tissue-of-origin for metastatic tumors and identifies tumor-associated cell populations; enables full-transcriptome biomarker discovery via attention mechanisms
comments: Multi-instance learning elegantly bridges the cell-to-sample gap without requiring pre-annotated cell types, though external validation on diverse tumor types would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Single-cell profiles can be aggregated via attention mechanisms to predict sample-level phenotypes without cell-type annotations
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; model successfully predicts tissue-of-origin and identifies disease-associated populations

title: Privacy-preserving pangenome graphs
task: Privacy-preserving release of pangenome graphs
